verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a first-party help-doc title, "Collecting tips with the Shopify POS," which shows Shopify POS has a documented tipping capability. Nothing in the pack describes how tip prompts are configured. Missing for 10: configurable tip percentages, smart tip amounts, custom tip entry, prompting on the card reader or terminal, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can configure tipping prompts (percentages, smart amounts, custom tips) collected on the reader or terminal
